sources.basis: Original Go interpretation of container/volume superblocks, object maps, filesystem B-tree records, inodes, streams, attributes and Fletcher 64. Native qualification is separate. Keylocker, ONEKEY and extent crypto_id interpretation follow the encryption chapter; native evidence qualifies outer XTS keybags and current extent flag 1 where published details are incomplete. Snapshot metadata/name records, physical snapshot superblocks and transaction-bounded historical resolution are original interpretations of the snapshot and object-map chapters. Fresh construction uses the container/checkpoint, object map, space manager, B-tree, inode/stream, hard-link sibling and extent-reference structures. Native fsck and continued macOS allocation independently qualify the constructed state. Multiple-volume construction uses nx_fs_oid slots, per-volume fs_index, reserves/quotas, group UUIDs and SYSTEM_OBJ_ID_MARK. The latter is independently observed in native System user objects and apfs_next_obj_id; UNIFIED_ID_SPACE_MARK is not used as the allocator base.

Original Go interpretation of volume headers, catalog and fork structures, B-tree traversal and native timestamps. Modern attributes and Finder behavior additionally reference the pinned Apple HFS source.
UDIF/GPT/APM layouts studied from v2 production code; independently implemented bounded full-disk reader. No test code imported.

Adapted hfs_zero_hidden_fields and the FinderInfo portion of hfs_vnop_getxattr. Go byte slices replace kernel cnode and vnode structures; public attribute results preserve native masking. Other reader structures are original Go interpretations of published layouts. Regular-file indirection follows cat_lookup/cat_resolvelink, including creation-date qualification and native inode identity. HFS+ comparison data translates gLatinCaseFold/gLowerCaseTable; the generator records the frozen UTF-16 comparison rules. The FinderInfo masking adaptation is shared by HFS+ reading and workspace edits. The hfs_vnop_setxattr/removexattr and hfs_set_bsd_flags behavior was also studied for native FinderInfo admission and hidden-bit coupling; workspace operations are original Go interpretations qualified against native final observations. HFS_XATTR_MAXSIZE in core/hfs.h supplies the common ordinary-attribute edit admission bound; resource forks retain their separate streaming limits.
sources.licenseBasis: The translated file header specifies APSL 2.0. The upstream root APPLE_LICENSE contains the older APSL 1.2 and is inventoried for provenance, not used as the license text for this translation.

sources.basis: Go adaptation of AppleDouble/ATTR wire layouts and packing sequence. Sources remain borrowed, records and output sizes are checked, and values stream in bounded chunks. Native copyfile leaves empty attribute offsets zero; this distinction is retained. Native metadata discovery, ACL/quarantine serialization, account lookup and host application policy are not ported. Independent COPYFILE_PACK/UNPACK controls qualify ordinary attributes, FinderInfo and resource forks.

Decoder-only translation adapted from the inventoried v2 production port and reviewed against Apple C. Encoders, allocating convenience APIs and encoder tables were removed. Caller-owned bounded destinations, checked byte slices and explicit errors replace C pointers. Complete LZFSE blocks must match their declared decoded size. Native public-codec and filesystem observations qualify the admitted decmpfs profiles.

Native symlink attributes include a final NUL which readlink/st_size exclude. Large ordinary attributes use storage flags 0x11 and the published stream layout; the extra bit has undocumented write semantics. Reading this specific encoding is compared byte-for-byte with native getxattr. This does not authorize ignoring other unknown bits or claim write compatibility.

Generation compiles the pinned normalizeOptCaseFoldU32Char and its local helpers and materializes the Unicode 16 mappings plus original combining classes in pure Go. ASCII folding and Hangul are algorithmic. HFS+ uses the separately frozen Unicode 3.2 decomposition/class data in vfs_utfconvdata.h. The checked inputs do not use the build host's Unicode library. Admission of unassigned/invalid native names and historical APFS profiles are outside current qualification. Native APFS observations independently qualify the selected comparison behavior; the APFS reference alone does not specify this modern profile. Workspace creation now also reuses the frozen HFS+ decomposition data to produce stored spelling; native tree-edit observations independently qualify UTF-16-unit limits and stored spelling.
sources.licenseBasis: Apple table and HFS source headers specify APSL 2.0. The Unicode scalar normalizer additionally acknowledges Unicode and IBM/ICU; those copyright notices and their permission texts are retained in generated source and LICENSES.

sources.basis: Independent native lstat lookups include Unicode 11/14/16 case pairs, hard-link aliases share st_ino/st_nlink and all forks/metadata, and F_LOG2PHYS_EXT proves more than eight physical extents per fragmented HFS+ data/resource fork. Full hashes and native boundary samples qualify portable reads. Native evidence for other required macOS producers is generated and replayed in CI.

Decoder-only translation adapted from the inventoried v2 production port. Reviewed against Corellium libzbitmap C; this is not Apple-published source. Output is caller-owned and bounded before each chunk. Apple public-codec output and native filesystem reads provide independent qualification.

Only production decoder algorithms were retained, with upstream notices; no tests, encoders, decmpfs Handle or legacy filesystem orchestration imported. LZ4 framing is a v2 original MIT implementation, not an Apple C port; v3 requires complete bounded frames. Each codec is independently requalified from fresh native observations.

Original bounded reader using the documented decmpfs_disk_header layout, maximum attribute size and UF_COMPRESSED admission behavior. Codec storage framing was studied from v2 production and independently installed/read on native volumes. XNU dispatch and kernel cnode implementation are not copied. Replacement also studies decmpfs_decompress_file, unset_compressed_flag and decmpfs_free_compressed_data: zero truncation clears UF_COMPRESSED and frees codec-owned storage plus the decmpfs attribute. No kernel code translated; original Go storage transitions are independently checked by native O_TRUNC writes. Unlike native writes, the preservation API keeps recorded source timestamps and marks modified contents explicitly.

Native ditto supplies LZVN filesystem storage. Apple public compression codecs supply other encoded payloads; final read-only kernel reads and public-codec decoding of stored bytes are independently compared. Types 1,3,4,7-16, stored markers, zlib optional checksum and resource descriptor gaps are exercised. Only 0xff is admitted as an LZFSE stored marker: a native malformed zero-marker file reports logical size but returns premature EOF; Go rejects it rather than synthesizing contents. macOS 15/26 may reject LZ4 types 15/16 at the filesystem layer even when their public codec decodes the stored bytes; CI records both outcomes explicitly.

GPL source studied for format facts: UUID-derived XTS outer bags, HMAC cookie, KEK/VEK DER layout and extent tweaks. No code copied or translated. Original bounded Go parsing and standard cryptographic constructions are independently checked against native Apple-created images. Legacy flag-2 key records remain explicitly unsupported.

Keybag entry alignment and key-record field study. DER lengths are big-endian. Structural and HMAC validation precede bounded password derivation; undocumented profiles do not fall through to authentication failure.

Header/API study only; no CommonCrypto C implementation copied or linked into Go. Native CCCryptor XTS, CCKeyDerivationPBKDF and CCSymmetricKeyWrap/Unwrap supply independent public vectors. AES-256-XTS vectors do not qualify a native APFS volume cipher profile.
Original bounded RFC 3394 unwrap with mandatory constant-time IV integrity verification, built on Go standard AES.

Original bounded multi-block PBKDF2 implementation with cancellation. APFS uses HMAC-SHA256 and encrypted DMG password records use HMAC-SHA1. Native CommonCrypto vectors and Apple-created images independently qualify the derived keys.

Production-only lessons; no test/harness material imported. v3 separates failed credentials, damaged key records and unsupported profiles, bounds aggregate derivation, validates HMAC and RFC3394 integrity, and uses per-extent tweaks. No v2 orchestration or cryptographic code copied.

Four Apple-created software-encrypted APFS volumes, 108 objects each, ordinary/Unicode/long/changed passwords and native rejection controls. Fresh read-only mounts with ownership enabled provide file and metadata hashes, including compressed files and modified clones. Native key records use flags 0, 40-byte wrapped keys, keybag version 2 and extent flag 1. Primitive reference bytes are independently generated with CommonCrypto. Broader key profiles require additional native evidence.
Published CSSM constants identify AES, 3DES, SHA1HMAC, PKCS5_PBKDF2, CBC_IV8, CBCPadIV8 and PKCS7 in native encrypted-image headers. Format identifiers studied; no Apple implementation copied.

Version 2 header, key-table and password-record layouts, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1, key-cookie and per-block IV derivation studied. Original bounded Go interpretation; no Python code copied or translated. Native macOS evidence independently qualifies AES wrapping and both payload key sizes.
Older encrypted-image layout and 3DES password-wrapping facts cross-checked against vfdecrypt. No C implementation copied or translated; fixed-offset and AES-128-only assumptions are not inherited.

Six Apple-created AES-128/256 encrcdsa v2 images cover APFS, case-sensitive APFS, HFS+, HFSX, UDZO and raw UDRW, Unicode/changed/rejected passwords and an independently encrypted APFS volume. Each has 107 observed objects from a final read-only mount. Current native password records wrap with AES-192-CBC, declare an 8-byte IV and use a zero-extended 16-byte AES IV. Retained capture and file/source hashes are immutable; older wrapping profiles require their own native CI evidence. Writer layout follows the observed 616-byte password slot, 122368-byte reserved header, 512-byte encrypted blocks and AES-192 password wrapping. It generates fresh cryptographic randomness and uses a fixed 600000-iteration derivation within the captured native range. Native output acceptance is required separately; the reader round trip is not its compatibility verdict.

Public snapshot enumeration and attribute ABI studied for an original Python ctypes collector. Kernel entitlement checks explain direct-call rejection; no kernel implementation copied. Apple asr and mount_apfs perform native snapshot creation and retention on disposable volumes.

Apple-created replication snapshots, UUID/XID inventory, native timestamps and final read-only historical mounts independently qualify two historical states alongside live state in ordinary, case-sensitive and nested encrypted APFS. The first saved superblock has no extended metadata OID; the live OID resolves the snapshot UUID at its XID. Unicode snapshot names and non-leaf snapshot metadata trees remain unqualified.

Four native APFS/HFS+/HFSX images, 125–126 entries each. Final read-only observations include logical file hashes, raw XATTR_SHOWCOMPRESSION values, native metadata, link identities and host-incompatible names. Apple copyfile independently packs/unpacks three metadata controls per filesystem. Portable output returns to macOS for an independent Python preservation comparison and native unpack, without invoking Go.

Four native before/after APFS/HFS+/HFSX images, 14 entries and seven content replacements each. Native truncate/write preserves inode/link identities, ordinary metadata and independent forks; active decmpfs types 3,4,8 become uncompressed with owned storage removed. Inactive malformed attributes survive. Portable results preserve before timestamps by policy while content/fork/link outcomes match after observations. Original sources and native post-write times remain independently recorded.

Four native before/after APFS/HFS+/HFSX profiles with 18 operations, eight rejection controls and six name-length probes each. Final read-only observations independently establish entry spelling, inode relationships, link counts, content, compression cleanup and attributes. Creation metadata and attribute bytes are explicit recorded inputs, including native process provenance. Source and supplied creation timestamps remain recorded by preservation policy. Native IDs for created objects are compared through a bijection of path/link groups; portable identities are explicitly marked as workspace-created. No C source is newly ported by the editor.

Four native before/after APFS/HFS+/HFSX profiles, 29 operations and seven rejections each. Final native read-only observations independently establish metadata precision, exact attributes, FinderInfo behavior, complete resource-fork truncation and identity through rename/hard links. Unspecified timestamps retain their source values by explicit portable policy. The retained local corpus uses same-owner assignment; fresh required CI captures must change UID/GID to 60001/60002 with native sudo on disposable image files. Native observation of resource forks precedes explicit timestamp assignment to avoid changing HFS+ atime during capture.

Go translation of setmode/getmode numeric and symbolic mode instructions. Explicit logical umask replaces process umask reads and signal masking; slices replace C allocation and instruction compaction. Native libc independently supplies 390 expression/mode/mask vectors per filesystem profile.

Command and traversal policy study; no cp implementation translated. Apple -a means -RpP and splits hard links; --preserve-links is an explicit portable extension. Bounded logical Go graph edits replace host syscall mutation. Independent native commands qualify the packaging journey; process authorization, account-name lookup and kernel caches are outside the logical session contract.

Four native before/after filesystem profiles, 23 Apple commands and five rejection controls each. noatime mounts avoid lazy read-cache effects. Automatic clock times normalize to a supplied fixed instant; explicit assignments retain native precision and birth-time coupling. Copied provenance remains exact; native process-injected provenance on new objects remains recorded but is outside portable process-authorization behavior. Local ownership uses same-owner assignment; required CI must change owners with sudo.

Immutable macOS 15 CI reference with actual UID/GID reassignment to 60001/60002. Native capture passed on all three Macs; the first portable replay exposed that physical recursive chown changes symlink ownership while chmod skips symlinks. The corrected implementation passes these saved native observations. This reference prevents same-owner local capture from hiding the difference.

Adapted InitVH, WriteExtentsFile, WriteAttributesFile and WriteCatalogFile header/map initialization to a fresh-volume Go planner. Core format/link/xattr sources guide catalog, legacy regular-file indirection and extent-based attributes. No kernel mutation or journal implementation is ported. Contiguous payload allocation, bounded bulk-loaded trees, explicit UTC clock and content-derived identity replace device writes, native defaults and random UUIDs. Native fsck and mounted observations independently qualify output.

Apple-created HFS+/HFSX inputs include a signed universal app, hard links, exact native metadata, attributes, independent resource forks and decmpfs types 1/3/4/7/8. Portable outputs are checked by hdiutil verify, fsck_hfs -fn, read-only native file observations and codesign on each Mac. A native encoder diagnostic established the 4 MiB maximum uncompressed UDIF chunk and checksum-covered type-0 zero runs; formatter probes established the attributes fork clump field and HFSX private-folder count flag. Source observations are retained unchanged.

Production-only study of UDIF checksum/blkx/footer fields, cross-checked against native hdiutil conversion. Original sequential Go encoder; no v2 tests, orchestration or code copied. Fixed 4 MiB chunks, bounded XML and explicit exact-source-length failures. Repacking also studies production-only block reconstruction, device/partition variants and signature footer offsets. Original strict resource admission and complete-coverage/CRC verification replace permissive reconstruction; no v2 tests were read or imported.

Original format research cross-check for flattened UDIF footer flags, device/partition variants, block resources and native plst placeholder. Reference only; no prose or implementation copied. Apple-tool acceptance supplies the independent compatibility verdict.

Apple-created raw, UDRO, UDZO and UDBZ disks; native raw-device full-disk SHA-256 and mounted file, fork, attribute, partition/volume, snapshot and encryption observations. Reuses independent signed-app and snapshot inputs with recorded parent provenance. Apple partitionDisk creates an APM free partition before seeding an unused sector; expected marker bytes are then read through the native device. Native signed and encrypted DMGs are explicit refusal controls. Every portable host output returns to each required Mac; no Go code supplies the native verdict. Native readback rejected a generic single-block device descriptor for raw APM input; native conversion supplies DDM/APM and GPT region descriptors, and raw-device hashes prove the resulting disk remains identical.

Production-only format study: space-manager geometry and native free-queue limits, checkpoint mapping, APFS B-tree records, name hashing and hard-link/document records. Original bounded container planner borrows filesystem.Reader and streams sorted output rather than importing v2 Entry trees, host adapters or mutation APIs. No v2 tests or harness imported. Apple format facts and independent native checks determine acceptance. Volume-group root/private IDs and reserve accounting were studied, but the v2 System user-inode base was rejected after a native kernel panic. Apple SYSTEM_OBJ_ID_MARK and captured native allocator state replace that assumption.

Expanded independent macOS 27 reference includes APFS and case-sensitive APFS alongside HFS+/HFSX, signed universal applications, exact birth/modification/change/access times, tracked documents, 53 filename lookup observations, links, attributes, forks, compression and an empty-directory construction root. Native fsck, mounted comparisons, codesign and writes through disposable shadows followed by check/remount qualify Go output. Prior HFS-only capture is retained unchanged under history. Local evidence does not replace the required macOS 15/26/27 CI matrix.

Independent Apple-created shared and grouped containers provide UUIDs, per-volume reserves/quotas/case/roles, group inventories, signed application trees and inode namespaces. Native shadow writes establish bounded quota/reserve enforcement, protected-volume allocation, independent writes and reuse after remount. Original references and copied capture sources remain immutable. Full macOS 15/26/27 capture, portable replay and VM-isolated native readback qualify output; fsck alone is insufficient.
